frequency_question: How often does an emerging market central bank implement a secondary or incremental reserve ratio instrument within any given two-month observation window?
membership_rule: Includes instances where a central bank introduces a supplemental or incremental reserve ratio requirement on commercial bank deposits. Excludes standard changes to baseline reserve requirements.

cases.name: Central Bank of Brazil Compulsory Deposit adjustment 2021

provenance_note: claims 400 cases from only 4 named (100.0x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 400 potential windows sampled; 3 instances identified where incremental secondary reserve ratios were deployed.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller frontier economies where data is less standardized.
skeleton: Quarterly policy windows across major emerging market central banks over a 20-year period (2004-2024)
multiplier: 80 quarters across 5 major central banks = 400 total windows, with 3 documented adoptions of incremental or emergency secondary reserve ratios.
validity_reason: Central banking liquidity management frameworks evolve slowly over multi-year horizons.
